title: Whispering Whelk Waltzer
statement: A pearly spiral-shelled sea snail who hums softly and slow-dances across a tank of moonlit teal water, trailing a ribbon of glowing plankton at every turn. Among drowsy kelp and a drowned music box, she spins whenever the bubbles from the filter hit a certain note, and she believes the whole aquarium is her ballroom.
